candidates.requirement: The execute target must link the bundled Oniguruma archive produced by the supplied build.
candidates.target_route: build.sh runs configure and make, then links tests/jq_fuzz_execute.cpp with libjq and Oniguruma.
candidates.failure_condition: The link command names modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a, while the supplied Makefile builds bundled Oniguruma under vendor/oniguruma; that archive path is not produced by the supplied build route.
candidates.alternative_paths: The execute link command gives one literal Oniguruma archive path and no fallback. The Makefile's bundled-library route uses vendor/oniguruma.
